title: Upgrade cantilever to 40x8x4 mesh with 5% EB tolerance
objective: Replace the coarse 4x2x1 cantilever test with a refined 40x8x4 mesh that achieves within 5% of Euler-Bernoulli beam theory prediction, as required by PLAN-A A10.3.
scope: Add new fixture cantilever_problem_refined with generate_hex8_mesh(40, 8, 4, 10.0, 2.0, 1.0)
Keep existing coarse-mesh tests as fast regression checks
implementation_steps: Read existing TestCantilever class in test_benchmarks.py
Add cantilever_problem_refined fixture generating 40x8x4 mesh on-the-fly
Set cg_max_iter=5000 for the larger system
Verify existing coarse-mesh tests still pass
deliverables: Both old and new cantilever tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Existing coarse-mesh cantilever tests still pass
risks: 40x8x4 mesh (12285 nodes) CG solve may be very slow in pure numpy. Mitigation: set cg_max_iter=5000, acceptable for @pytest.mark.slow.

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu and not e2e' -q

completion_notes: Fixture generates 40x8x4 mesh on-the-fly, cg_max_iter=5000 for larger system
